eps.ov: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

eps.t: There Is No Magic in This Other World
eps.ov: After yearning for magic throughout his first life, Shion lives his second life in another world without magic. But his sister's discovery at a lake has given him hope. As he researches the luminous phenomenon, he feels his dream stir back to life.

Goblins are sighted near the village. Gawain goes to hunt them while Shion and others from the village hide in the mansion for protection. Suddenly, there's a pounding at the door and a window shatters—a goblin has broken into the mansion.
Shion's father finally approves of his magic research, which leads Shion to a new discovery. Marie seems troubled as she devotes herself to her sword.
Shion and Marie's relationship is mostly back to normal. Now, Grast has a problem that only Shion can solve.
Left shaken by his father's words, Shion continues his research by taking it into the field to hunt monsters.

eps.t: Daily Life Begins to Break Down
eps.ov: Two years after Shion and the others' first monster hunt, a mysterious red light flashes through the clouds.
Marie is gravely ill and strange monsters have attacked. Shion is determined to do everything he can to help.
Shion devotes himself to finding a cure for lethargy sickness. Rose, worried for her friends, offers to help.
The night menace appears once more. Shion and the others race out to defend Istria from horde of wraiths.
Ainswelf's arrival changes everything. Shion steps up to challenge a foe far more powerful than himself.
Exhausted from the battle, Shion sleeps for a week. He wakes to concerned faces and a mysterious phenomenon.
